sources.title: Overview | Marlowe
sources.snippet: Music / AI · Stanford University IT Marlowe Computing Spotlight: Elizabeth Schumann Group Elizabeth Schumann, an assistant professor of music, is building a screen-free companion that prompts children toward child-led musical exploration. Her group trains the unified text-music model behind it on Marlowe, moving from single-GPU prototypes to multi-machine, multi-GPU runs.

sources.title: Marlowe: Analytical AI for Fiction, Not Generative AI
